policy: Independent fictional mythology archive; religious overview describes in-universe beliefs, not real-world doctrine. No affiliation with Blizzard. Suggested sources require editorial verification.

traditions.title: The High Heavens
traditions.tagline: Celestial order and the Eternal Conflict

traditions.title: The Burning Hells
traditions.tagline: The Great Evils and infernal dominion

history.title: The Eternal Conflict
history.body: The High Heavens and Burning Hells wage a cosmic struggle.

history.title: Creation of Sanctuary
history.body: Inarius and Lilith are central to the creation of a refuge from the Eternal Conflict.

history.title: The Nephalem
history.body: The descendants of angels and demons possess extraordinary potential.

history.title: The Sin War
history.body: Competing powers seek influence over humanity and its latent power.

history.title: The Dark Exile
history.body: The Prime Evils are exiled to Sanctuary following conflict within the Burning Hells.

history.title: The Horadrim
history.body: A brotherhood forms to oppose the Prime Evils and contain their influence.

history.title: The Worldstone
history.body: The Worldstone shapes Sanctuary's history and is destroyed by Tyrael after Baal's corruption.

history.title: The Return of Lilith
history.body: Lilith returns to Sanctuary amid religious conflict and competing visions for humanity.

entries.title: Anu and Tathamet
entries.body: Creation myth describing primordial unity, division and the origins of the cosmic conflict.

entries.title: Crystal Arch
entries.body: Celestial structure associated with the birth of angels.

entries.title: Pandemonium
entries.body: Contested cosmic region associated with the Eternal Conflict and the Worldstone.

entries.title: Angiris Council
entries.body: Council of archangels associated with Valor, Justice, Hope, Fate and Wisdom.

entries.title: Tyrael
entries.body: Archangel of Justice who later relinquishes his angelic nature.

entries.title: Malthael
entries.body: Former Archangel of Wisdom who becomes the Angel of Death.

entries.title: Prime Evils
entries.body: Diablo, Mephisto and Baal embody Terror, Hatred and Destruction.

entries.title: Lesser Evils
entries.body: Andariel, Duriel, Belial and Azmodan embody Anguish, Pain, Lies and Sin.

entries.title: Lilith
entries.body: Daughter of Mephisto and co-creator of Sanctuary.

entries.title: Cathedral of Light
entries.body: Faith centered on Inarius in the Sin War and later manifestations.

entries.title: Triune
entries.body: Religious organization associated with the influence of the Prime Evils.

entries.title: Zakarum
entries.body: Faith of the Light whose institutions are infiltrated by Mephisto.

entries.title: Priests of Rathma
entries.body: Necromantic tradition concerned with maintaining the Balance.

entries.title: Horadrim
entries.body: Order of scholars and mages founded to combat the Prime Evils.

entries.title: Soulstones
entries.body: Artifacts used to contain powerful demonic essences, with dangerous consequences.

entries.title: Black Soulstone
entries.body: Artifact created by Zoltun Kulle that can contain angelic and demonic souls.

entries.title: Worldstone
entries.body: Artifact central to Sanctuary's creation and the suppression of nephalem power.

entries.title: Imperius
entries.body: Aspect of Valor; militant defender of Heaven.

entries.title: Auriel
entries.body: Aspect of Hope; associated with sustaining celestial resolve.

entries.title: Itherael
entries.body: Aspect of Fate; studies possible destinies.

entries.title: Inarius
entries.body: Renegade angel who helped create Sanctuary with Lilith.

entries.title: Diablo
entries.body: Lord of Terror; recurring central adversary.

entries.title: Mephisto
entries.body: Lord of Hatred; father of Lilith.

entries.title: Baal
entries.body: Lord of Destruction; corrupts the Worldstone.

entries.title: Andariel
entries.body: Maiden of Anguish.

entries.title: Duriel
entries.body: Lord of Pain.

entries.title: Belial
entries.body: Lord of Lies.

entries.title: Azmodan
entries.body: Lord of Sin.

entries.title: Rathma
entries.body: Also known as Linarian, an early nephalem associated with the Balance.

entries.title: Uldyssian
entries.body: Human whose awakened potential becomes central to the Sin War.

entries.title: Trag'Oul
entries.body: Mysterious dragon associated with Sanctuary and the Balance.

entries.title: Sisters of the Sightless Eye
entries.body: Rogue sisterhood with martial and mystical traditions.

entries.title: Druids of Scosglen
entries.body: Practitioners of nature magic and shapeshifting.

entries.title: Spiritborn
entries.body: Warriors whose traditions involve the Spirit Realm and guardian spirits.

entries.title: Khazra
entries.body: Goatlike beings whose origins and corruption are explored in Sanctuary lore.

entries.title: Tristram
entries.body: Site of the cathedral and the first game's central crisis.

entries.title: Mount Arreat
entries.body: Barbarian sacred mountain formerly housing the Worldstone.

entries.title: Kurast
entries.body: Seat of Zakarum power and setting of Mephisto's corruption.

entries.title: Westmarch
entries.body: Kingdom devastated during Malthael's campaign.

entries.title: Caldeum
entries.body: City central to Belial's plot.

entries.title: Nahantu
entries.body: Southern jungle region central to Vessel of Hatred.

entries.title: Skovos
entries.body: Island homeland associated with the Amazons.

entries.title: Diablo
entries.body: A hero confronts Terror beneath Tristram and becomes its next vessel.

entries.title: Diablo II
entries.body: The Dark Wanderer's journey leads to confrontations with the Prime Evils.

entries.title: Lord of Destruction
entries.body: Baal's corruption of the Worldstone ends with its destruction.

entries.title: Diablo Immortal
entries.body: Adventures follow the destruction of the Worldstone, before Diablo III.

entries.title: Diablo III
entries.body: The Black Soulstone becomes central to the return of the Prime Evil.

entries.title: Reaper of Souls
entries.body: Malthael turns against humanity, threatening mortal souls.

entries.title: Diablo IV
entries.body: Lilith returns several decades after the preceding crisis.

entries.title: Vessel of Hatred
entries.body: Neyrelle travels toward Nahantu carrying Mephisto's soulstone.

entries.title: Spirit Realm
entries.body: A sacred parallel plane formed during the changing of the Worldstone; human belief influences its shape.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Akarat
entries.body: A prophet of Xiansai and Nahantu ancestry who explored the Spirit Realm and taught humanity's inner capacity to resist darkness.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Ysevete
entries.body: Akarat's disciple whose teachings helped establish Spiritborn culture.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Spirit Guardians
entries.body: Jaguar, Gorilla, Eagle and Centipede exemplify distinct relationships between humanity and nature.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Spiritborn funerary belief
entries.body: Followers aspire to join the Spirit Realm after death and protect harmony between worlds.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Askari
entries.body: The people of Skovos, governed by an Amazon Queen and an Oracle Queen.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Firstborn civilization
entries.body: Skovos is described as the original home of Sanctuary's creators and an early center of civilization.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Temis
entries.body: Capital of Skovos and setting for the arrival of a mysterious prophet.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Lord of Hatred
entries.body: The 2026 expansion moves the struggle against Mephisto to Skovos.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Paladins
entries.body: Warriors whose understanding of the Light permits righteous mortals to draw upon it.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Warlocks
entries.body: Practitioners who turn infernal powers against their demonic adversaries.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending

entries.title: Cult of the Dead
entries.body: A continuing seasonal storyline concerns returning dead and the cult's purposes; distinguish seasonal narrative from campaign chronology.
entries.status: Supported by official overview; detailed campaign review pending
